fit.summary: Years of counter and floor work with cash, complaints, and evening shifts; no hotel or PMS experience.

bullets.text: Handled counter complaints and turned most of them into return visits

cover_letter.hook: A front desk that stays calm on a busy evening is what I have been doing behind counters for 5 years, and I would like to do it at Bluffview Inn & Suites.
cover_letter.body:
At Hillside Coffee Co. I opened the shop alone 3 mornings a week, from the cash count to the first rush, and handled complaints at the counter. At Copper Pot Bistro I work weekend doubles and train new servers on the menu and POS.

I balanced my register to the penny on every shift as a cashier, and I am used to evenings, weekends, and holidays.
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your evening desk works with housekeeping on late check-ins.

gaps: No hotel or PMS experience; Opera PMS is a plus and Jasmine has not used it.
Fresh Fold Laundry left off to keep the page to the four most relevant jobs.
